name: TeTeT's Vietnam War Vessels
summary: Large Vietnam-era pack of US Navy ships, riverine craft, AI aircraft and ground assets.
description:
Includes Essex-class carriers, CVAN-65 Enterprise, USS New Jersey, destroyers and frigates, PBR and Tango river boats, junks, sampans, AI aircraft such as the F-8 and A-1, and base buildings. Place the `Mods` folder in `Saved Games\DCS`; delete old `Mods/tech` and `Mods/aircraft` folders before upgrading.

Requires: Some ships (Maddox, The Sullivans) moved to the separate Cold War Vessels release.

releases.changelog: Adds AOE-1 USS Sacramento and unit payloads; hitpoint rebalance; fleet ship and river boat updates.
